title: Observers at the Planck scale reason in paraconsistent logic

statements.text: A theorem classically true but non-computable becomes computable but non-decidable at the Planck scale, because the logic of observers in a quantum-computing universe changes from standard quantum and classical logic to paraconsistent logic.

sources.quote: This fact is due to the change of logic for observers in a quantumcomputing universe: from standard quantum logic and classical logic, to paraconsistent logic
